desc:
A Turn-based strategy game where you work together with other players or bots to defeat the enemy in many different campaigns. These range from historical inspired campaigns to fictional. Complete campaigns to later unlock more units and advance your tech tree. The units in the game range from the interwar period to the late cold war.

V6.1 changelog:
New Units:
Tank hunter (TD pre-evo)
Heavy AT gun (AT gun evo)
SAM battery (AA cannon evo)
Unit changes:
Lorry rework with anims
Skins:
French infantry overhauled
Australia skin for 200 gems
General balancing
AA trees moved to Air slots
PvP rewards increased for consecutive wins by 0.2x every win until 2x
+2 air slots
Combat engineer + cargo transport XP requirement reduced by 20%
Campaigns reorganised
